dataAssets.name: Modulo workspace state
dataAssets.description: Server-backed PARA, plugin and workspace records.
dataAssets.backupPolicy: verified Oracle database and application-state snapshot; off-host copy when configured
dataAssets.retentionPolicy: retain current state and dated recovery snapshots
dataAssets.recoveryProcedure: deploy/oci/restore-drill.sh and the Oracle recovery runbook

dataAssets.name: Oracle PostgreSQL state
dataAssets.description: Modulo and Keycloak relational application state.
dataAssets.backupPolicy: nightly verified logical dump plus off-host restic when configured
dataAssets.retentionPolicy: retain according to production recovery policy

dataAssets.name: Noesis authoritative state
dataAssets.description: Research source, provenance and durable Noesis application data.
dataAssets.backupPolicy: volume archive in the verified Oracle snapshot; off-host copy when configured
dataAssets.retentionPolicy: retain source and provenance state; do not discard because indexes can be rebuilt
dataAssets.recoveryProcedure: deploy/oci/restore-drill.sh followed by Noesis lifecycle verification

dataAssets.name: Oracle deployment definitions
dataAssets.description: Compose, reverse-proxy, systemd, lifecycle and release helpers.
dataAssets.backupPolicy: Git history plus verified repository backup
dataAssets.retentionPolicy: retain full history and release manifests
dataAssets.recoveryProcedure: clone the repository and run deploy/oci/schema.sh

dataAssets.name: Oracle verified snapshots
dataAssets.sourceOfTruth: Backup job output and checksum manifest
dataAssets.backupPolicy: enabled systemd timer; off-host repository is required for independent protection
dataAssets.retentionPolicy: retain verified local snapshots under the documented retention policy

dataAssets.name: Noesis model cache
dataAssets.description: Re-downloadable model and tokenizer cache used by Noesis.
dataAssets.backupPolicy: excluded from production snapshots; restore by pinned download
dataAssets.retentionPolicy: cache may be discarded during recovery or maintenance
dataAssets.recoveryProcedure: recreate the volume and fetch only pinned, licensed models
